notes: bomb.v1 allocates 64 MiB slabs until the M1 policy's 1.5 GiB RLIMIT_AS cap raises MemoryError (Linux). The handler catches the error and sleeps forever so the runner's wall watchdog kills the group; the observed status is timeout with fail_reason=RESOURCE_LIMIT. On macOS the cap is best-effort and the same watchdog backstop applies. Bounded; no receipt is written.
